# `wholesale_invoice_line`

Area: **wholesale** ([all tables](README.md))

One charge of a wholesale invoice, as imported, with the product it was matched to.

| `product_id` | `uuid` | yes |  | The product that held the MSISDN on the period start (number assignment history, cancelled claims ignored), else the one whose SIM had the ICCID; NULL when none did. |
